items.title: Costco Stock Is Priced For Two Good Years, Is That A Safe Bet?
items.summary: Costco Wholesale (COST) trades at about $928 a share, roughly 43.5 times the last twelve months of adjusted earnings, meaning normalized net income with stock-based compensation added back, a basis meant to sit closer to what analysts use in their forecasts. For a warehouse retailer, that is a growth company's price. What it leaves out is what analysts expect Costco to earn by fiscal 2028.

items.title: Prediction: Costco Could Be Worth More Than Home Depot and Lowe's Combined by 2030. Here's the Math.
items.summary: Costco doesn't need to reinvent retail to overtake the home improvement giants. It just needs to keep doing what has worked so well for its members, warehouses, and bottom line.

items.title: Costco (COST) Drawn Into Expanded DOJ Beef Pricing Antitrust Probe
items.summary: Costco Wholesale (NasdaqGS:COST) has been asked by the US Department of Justice for detailed records as part of an expanded antitrust investigation into beef pricing. The broadened probe now covers major food retailers, with authorities seeking information on pricing practices and supply chain arrangements for beef products. The inquiry raises potential regulatory and operational questions for Costco as a key buyer and seller of beef in the US grocery market. Consider reviewing other...
